name: Apartement Tiroler Haus
beschreibung: Apartement Tiroler Haus is an inviting holiday apartment nestled in the heart of Tyrol, Austria. Situated in a peaceful setting, it boasts breathtaking views of the surrounding alpine landscape. The accommodation features a combined living and sleeping area, a well-appointed kitchenette, and an en-suite bathroom with shower. A private balcony is also part of the setup. Traditional wooden furnishings give the interior a cosy, authentic flair. Guests enjoy full independence to explore the area, with prime ski resorts and hiking paths readily accessible.
